name: cineplex-monorepo
description: Root workspace for Cineplex Cinema Management System

scripts.mobile:get: npm run mobile:update-ip && cd mobile/mobile_shared && flutter pub get && cd ../cineplex_client && flutter pub get && cd ../cineplex_staff && flutter pub get && cd ../cineplex_admin && flutter pub get
scripts.mobile:analyze: cd mobile/mobile_shared && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos && cd ../cineplex_client && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos && cd ../cineplex_staff && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos && cd ../cineplex_admin && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos
scripts.mobile:client: npm run mobile:update-ip && cd mobile/cineplex_client && flutter run --dart-define-from-file=.env
scripts.mobile:staff: npm run mobile:update-ip && cd mobile/cineplex_staff && flutter run --dart-define-from-file=.env
scripts.mobile:admin: npm run mobile:update-ip && cd mobile/cineplex_admin && flutter run --dart-define-from-file=.env
scripts.mobile:client:build: npm run mobile:update-ip && cd mobile/cineplex_client && flutter build apk --dart-define-from-file=.env
scripts.mobile:staff:build: npm run mobile:update-ip && cd mobile/cineplex_staff && flutter build apk --dart-define-from-file=.env
scripts.mobile:admin:build: npm run mobile:update-ip && cd mobile/cineplex_admin && flutter build apk --dart-define-from-file=.env
